protocol.position_source: TRI_GROUND debug[3] only, signed PB0-PC0; counts and counts/s; angle calibration unavailable

ground.grouping: Four large commands form each complete cycle; event cycle -1 is initial hold only

protocol.initialization: Exactly once per declared complete cycle/repetition: first valid corrected sample, previous recorded command and command-only approach direction/history. Exclude pre-initialization unavailable rows. No observed-position correction or state reset at command edges. Initial observed sample excluded from error scoring.
protocol.prediction: Every recorded timestamp and command advances the same portable C core. Stale/unavailable position targets are unscored, not interpolated; they do not stop model time or reset state.
protocol.valid_target: Status bits0..3; raw0/2 within ADC range with no PB0 rail or PC0 ceiling, exact debug3=debug0-debug2. PC0 zero accepted and counted. Corrected -1 is valid; -32768 is unavailable. debug4 age retained explicitly, freshness from flagbit3.
protocol.fitting: All parameters and static-map initialization use training units only. Deterministic bounded optimizer and fixed budget. Validation target arrays must never be passed to objective/initial guesses. Model selection reports all predefined baselines; no validation-driven retuning.
protocol.holdout_caveat: All recordings were previously inspected for exploratory characterization. These units are held out from this fit/tuning, not a pristine prospective experiment; model architecture reflects that earlier knowledge.
metrics: fresh-row MAE/RMSE and95th absolute error in corrected counts
per-unit and equally weighted per-unit aggregate
first150ms transient and final100ms plateau subsets
protocol.limits: Small single-fixture dataset and at most three held-out units; electrical proxy lacks independently measured angle, load, excitation/reference isolation and direct PWM-edge timing. Good replay does not authorize flight compensation or prove identified mechanical parameters.

settings.objective: Mean over complete training units of their fresh-row mean squared corrected-count error; exclude exactly the initialization row; no filtering or target interpolation.
settings.optimizer: Deterministic bounded Nelder-Mead in normalized coordinates, clipping candidates to declared bounds; one fixed engineering-prior start per baseline; no validation-driven restarts.
settings.map_initialization: Median fresh last100ms plateau samples at each knot across training units only; median fresh training samples nearest knot if no plateau.

baselines.static: Three optimized map knots, all dynamics/hysteresis disabled
baselines.lag: Three optimized map knots plus one common tau, no delay/backlash/rate limit
baselines.full: Three map knots, play backlash, common delay, directional tau and directional rate limits
